summary: Mistral released version 2.24.4 of its mistral-vibe CLI tool, adding session title generation, queue editing, git info display, connection reuse for faster tool-turn responses, and several bug fixes around retries, auth routing, and connection handling.

practices.reason: Fixes to auth routing and connection handling change what an integrating team needs to account for when using the CLI's connector and chat-completion flows.
practices.quote: `/mcp login <connector>` routes to the connector auth flow

practices.reason: Reusing model connections across tool turns is a latency-reducing serving technique but no gain is quantified and it applies only within this tool's own client.
practices.quote: Model connections are reused across tool turns for faster responses
